set.body: Audit every criterion in PRD Acceptance Criteria A-1 through A-23 against source, tests, cross-platform evidence, validation artifacts, documentation, and hosted release proof. Includes A-3 kernel purity, A-14 no null or throw from a pure path and no silent cardinality change, A-22 ObservedTimeline requirements, and A-23 conditional generic codec requirements. Missing evidence remains a named release blocker.
set.title: Acceptance criteria audit A-1 through A-23
